title: Layout_02
slide_intent: Reveal a content panel in sequence so a viewer can distinguish the message from the image behind it.
strategic_value: A white card with red DB marks can preserve message clarity over active imagery.
demonstration: A narrow white strip expands into a left-hand card containing the DB logo, headline, copy, and bottom Schwelle, then retracts.
practical_value: Choose a panel over imagery when the message needs an independent reading surface.

content_islands.name: Panel entrance
content_islands.spec: Expand the narrow white strip into a card on the left of the employee image.

content_islands.name: Content and exit
content_islands.spec: Introduce logo, headline, copy, and red bars within the card, then retract it.
